title: Google K-12 - Gemini aur Search Off Jab Tak Admin On Na Kare
content:
Google ne schools ke liye bada control
change announce kiya hai.
K-12 student accounts pe Gemini, Gemini
Notebook, Gemini in Classroom, aur Google
Search -
yeh sab ENTIRELY OFF rahenge jab tak
school admin explicitly on na kare.
Primary source: Google blog, 3 Nov 2026.
Chris Phillips, VP and General Manager of
Education, ne likha:
after listening to schools, teachers,
researchers and policymakers,
access to these 4 products will be
entirely off for K-12 student accounts
until administrators turn them on.
Aur rollout se pehle schools ko specifics
milenge coming months mein.
Saath mein GUIDED LEARNING aa raha hai.
Idea simple hai: AI seedha final answer na
de, step-by-step questions se student ko
sochne pe force kare.
Google Classroom mein Guided Learning ab
globally available hai, teacher-assigned
activities ke saath.
Search ke liye Guided Learning
capabilities student accounts pe build ho
rahe hain.
Pilot select U.S. schools mein later this
month start hoga.
Lesson clear hai.
Education buyers ab "AI on by default"
nahi maang rahe.
Woh admin control, audit, aur learning
design maang rahe hain.
Agar tum school, coaching, ya edtech ke
liye AI bana rahe ho,
OFF-BY-DEFAULT + teacher override ab table
stakes hai.
How to use this today.
Agar tumhara product students ko touch karta hai:
1. Default OFF for minors unless an admin opts in.
2. Separate "tutor mode" jo answers dump na kare.
3. Teacher dashboard: kahan class stuck hai.
4. Clear message when a tool is disabled
by the school.
Google literally keh raha hai Search aur
AI deeply integrated hain -
so schools jo AI band karte hain, Search
bhi lose kar sakte hain. Design for that
conflict.
Maan lo tum ek coaching institute ke liye
AI tutor bana rahe ho.
Student physics problem paste karta hai.
Wrong design: seedha numerical answer.
Right design: pehle formula poochho, phir
steps, phir final check.
Aur institute admin decide kare tool on
hai ya nahi.
Wahi Google ka Guided Learning direction hai.
Mera take simple hai.
AI in schools ka fight ab model IQ pe
nahi, control pe hai.
Jo teams admin trust + PRODUCTIVE STRUGGLE
design karti hain, woh win karti hain.
Cheating shortcuts short-term hype hain.
Learning gains long-term product hain.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
